The '''Authorized Shipper List''' was a list of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] who had agreed to pay prices for the transport and services of goods as set by the [[Guild of Interstellar Merchants]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]].
